Frequently Asked Questions

What is the actual GPU TGP wattage of Dell G15 5530 (i7-13650HX / RTX 4060 8GB)?

The Dell G15 5530 (i7-13650HX / RTX 4060 8GB) features a 140W Max TGP (Alienware Command Center + MUX Switch) rating for its NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 8GB GDDR6. This ensures stable framerates without thermal throttling under sustained gaming loads.

Can I upgrade the RAM and SSD on this laptop?

Yes! It has 2x SO-DIMM slots (Expandable up to 32GB) and 2x M.2 NVMe slots. You can easily drop in an additional 16GB RAM stick or high-speed Gen4 NVMe SSD at home without voiding warranty.

Is this laptop recommended for programming, coding, and college?

Dell G15 5530 (i7-13650HX / RTX 4060 8GB) scores 9.8/10 for software engineering. Its Intel Core i7-13650HX (14 Cores: 6P + 8E, 20 Threads, up to 4.9 GHz) easily handles Docker, multiple IDEs, compiling code, and virtual machines.
